comparison.objective: Set a telescoping gauge to a bore diameter and place it on a stand; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: In-bore centering, frictional sweep, locking, extraction without disturbing span, and placement versus blade-mediated latch deflection and wire-tool pulling.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge span within 0.10 mm and properly released on the stand; candidate requires terminal removal without damage or unintended release, though numeric limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Both extract a tool from a cavity, but the tested abilities and measured outcome are fundamentally different.
